protocol.purpose: Project-agnostic user-task benchmark definitions; no assumptions about preferred Quill tools or prompt-specific routes.
protocol.status: templates_unbound; not an executable scored project suite until binding and independent oracle are frozen

project_binding.selection: Build the eligible anchor inventory independently of Quill and model runs. Use stable seeded selection stratified by scope, kind, module, annotation complexity and graph size; record the entire candidate pool and exclusions. No swapping after seeing outcomes.
project_binding.scope: Apply to Maven or Gradle, single or multi-module, Java/Kotlin as present. Honor the project CDI version and javax/jakarta namespace; do not assume latest Quarkus defaults.
project_binding.no_universal_feature_claim: All 50 definitions transfer; not all 50 features exist in every application. Publish applicable/50 and blocked/50. No fabricated anchors or production mutations to fill absent features.
project_binding.oracle_separation: Keep full oracle, selectors, expected_fields and scoring private. Only rendered user prompt and neutral public context reach the tested model. Compile a separate bound suite rather than passing this template document to the old runner.

comparison.without_quill: No MCP, Quill index, managed Quill instructions/hooks, oracle files, prior-run helpers or shared mutable CLI homes. Same source, normal build artifacts and standard toolchain are available.
comparison.with_native_quill: Wait for full index readiness and capture its source/compiled hashes, warnings and build state. Use real end-user opt-in hooks and direct tools; do not inject handpicked facts. One native MCP initialization per CLI session; no restart/prewarm between linked turns.
comparison.isolation: Fresh disposable checkouts and private CLI/session/config/helper directories per arm and repeat. Freeze original config and restore it. Session histories never cross arms. Model-generated temporary scripts never cross cases.
comparison.runner: No forced tool calls, question-dependent schema catalogs, answer projection, hidden evidence queries, fact/format repair prompts or passing gold answers. Record native tool outputs unchanged.
comparison.order: Freeze randomized balanced arm order before running; planned repeats remain attempts, not retries selected for best result. No paid run is authorized by this definition.

prompt_robustness.rule: Two natural wordings per independent task; use the same chosen variant in both paired arms. Reserve additional independent paraphrases as holdout before patch work. Do not alter Quill to recognize these exact strings.
prompt_robustness.identities: Mix short unambiguous names, fully qualified names, overloaded method signatures and truly ambiguous names via preflight strata. A clarification is correct only for actual ambiguity; both arms receive the same clarification information.
prompt_robustness.no_magic_output: Do not require boilerplate English text, .class files under target/classes, particular JSON keys or a literal tool name merely to activate prefetch.

sessions.independent: CQ-001..CQ-048 each starts a fresh session; CQ-049 a fresh disposable coding session. Selectors may bind the same symbol, but never reuse prior conversation or helpers.
sessions.linked: CQ-050 is six turns on one connected flow. One MCP/session, no clearing/reindexing between turns. All follow-ups prewritten and identical in paired arms, with anchors from the same flow. Russian follow-ups are the initial linked language; English independent prompts are supplied, not a claim of an already translated linked holdout.
sessions.count: 50 scenario definitions; at most 55 user turns per arm per repeat if all are applicable, because CQ-050 has six turns. Not 50 independent prompts.
sessions.cache: Record provider cache creation/read and raw request prefix fingerprints. Cold/warm are separate strata; AB/BA alone does not prove equal cache state. Do not compare independent latency to amortized linked latency.

scoring.correctness: Frozen per-field independent facts; exact symbol/signature identity, set precision/recall and explicit evidence boundaries. Whole-case correct requires all mandatory claims and no conflicting claim. Parse presentation separately; method-name questions may accept parentheses, signature questions remain strict.
scoring.negative_cases: An empty proven result is valid. Unknown is correct only when the oracle marks a specific unknown and the answer explains it; generic uncertainty is not a free pass.
scoring.oracle_readiness: Each bound case needs reviewed expected values, allowed alternatives, disallowed overclaims and evidence locations before model calls. Runtime questions without a safe independent oracle are blocked, not accepted from plausible reasoning.
scoring.patch: CQ-049 additionally requires patch application on the frozen checkout, production/test compilation and focused behavior tests; passing the same tests before/after is insufficient if changed behavior is untested. Never mutate production repository during case binding.
scoring.failures: Save all started attempts, partial responses and billable usage. Never replace a failed answer or transport incident silently; incomplete usage blocks unconditional acceptance.
scoring.decision: Compare clients, cache strata and independent/linked tracks separately. Require no correctness drop and no increase of total or uncached input tokens; report output separately. No overall acceptance if any mandatory stratum is missing/unknown. Publish per-case regressions even if aggregate passes.
scoring.efficiency: Token factor = sum(input cached+new + output) without / same sum with; uncached factor computed separately. Cost uses actual version-pinned rates for cache read/write/new input/output or actual billed usage; unknown cost is null. Never average per-case factors or multiply gains from different experiments.
scoring.time: Report index preparation, CLI/MCP readiness, model time and total wall time separately; end-to-end includes readiness. Source-only receives equivalent ordinary build preparation.
scoring.target: 4x is a hypothesis, not a selection criterion for removing difficult or unfavorable cases.
